title: Leon Wankum: BTC Taking on Real Estate’s $300T Monetary Premium
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Leon Wankum: BTC Taking on Real Estate’s $300T Monetary Premium Property was once the default wealth store, but Leon Wankum argues that run is over. He explains why Bitcoin is stripping real estate of its monetary premium. This post Leon Wankum: BTC Taking on Real Estate’s $300T Monetary Premium first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
